en.name: iMyCard
en.subtitle: Encrypted wallet on your phone
en.short_description: Cards, IDs and notes in an AES-256 vault, unlocked by face or finger.
en.description:
MyCard is a private wallet. Everything you put in it is encrypted on your device and unlocked with your face, fingerprint, or device passcode.

WHAT YOU CAN KEEP
44 card types across seven groups — payment and loyalty cards, ID documents and passports, travel and event passes, business cards, digital keys, notes, tasks and reminders. Add the fields that matter for each one; MyCard knows which are sensitive and masks them until you ask.

HOW IT IS PROTECTED
The vault is sealed with AES-256-GCM. GCM authenticates the whole file, so a tampered vault fails to open instead of silently decrypting to garbage. The key lives in the platform secure store, never in the vault file. "Erase all data" deletes every card and destroys the key — there is no copy anywhere else, so that is final.

STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
There is no account, no cloud sync, and no server. MyCard has no network code at all. Nothing you store can be read by us, because nothing you store ever reaches us.

ORGANISE IT
Tag cards, filter by group, archive what you are done with, and search the lot.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
MyCard is a private wallet. Everything you put in it is encrypted on your device and unlocked with your face, fingerprint, or device passcode.

Intended audience:
Encrypted wallet on your phone

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
None. The app works entirely on the device and calls no external service.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (locale 1, locale 10, locale 11, locale 12, locale 2, locale 3, locale 4, locale 5, locale 6, locale 7, locale 8, locale 9). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
